It's like chewing gum for your hands rub in your hands to heat up and make a vibrant color, put in the fridge to change it back ."]

2714.title: Ideal Magnetic Go Snakes n' Ladders
2714.description: ["Ideal Magnetic Go Snakes n' Ladders features a game board with no-slip magnetic pieces, making this the perfect activity for gaming on-the-go! Play on a car trip, a boat, a bus or plane; the board folds up to be small enough to carry around anywhere! Race your opponent to the 100th space, with the help of ladders and without sliding down the snakes. This children's game measures 15in. x 10.25in. open and 5in. x 10.25in. when closed. As a bonus, you can also play Nim, where players remove pieces from the board, you just don't want to be the one to remove the last. Includes a game board, 16 magnetic pieces, spinner and instructions. Recommended for children 5 years of age and older.", 'Ideal is a member of the ALEX Brands family of products and has been setting the standard for toys and games for over 100 years. From strategy board games, to classic building toys, to outdoor activities, there is something to challenge everyone. Ideal products are a fun way to develop problem-solving, social, and logical skills. Visit www.amazon.com/alex-brands for more information on ALEX Brands and our best-selling line of educational and entertaining products for kids.']

2715.title: LEGO Super Heroes Iron Skull Sub Attack 76048
2715.description: ["Iron Skull has trapped him in his awesome Iron Skull Sub! Go deep underwater with Scuba Iron Man to save your fellow Avenger. Fend off attacks by the Hydra diver on his underwater jet and dodge the Sub's stud shooters. Then face off against Iron Skull and defeat him to free Scuba Captain America!.", 'By LEGO']

2716.title: Fisher-Price Loving Family SUV
2716.description: ['Fisher-Price Loving Family SUV: Road trip. The whole Loving Family gang gets rolling (along with kids imaginations) in this stylish SUV. And when kids roll it along, theyll hear revving sounds. Theres room for six, with three doors that open and close and a sunroof that makes it easy for little hands to place the figures inside. (Figures sold separately.) So flip down the tailgate, throw in the bags, press the radio button to hear a fun song, and its off to a fun Loving Family vacation.', 'By Fisher Price']

2717.title: Fisher-Price Loving Family Parents' Bedroom
2717.description: ['Every parent would love to come home to a bedroom like this! Its loaded with contemporary charm, from the beautiful removable comforter and soft accent pillows to the vanity with flip-up mirror and matching chair. And parents arent the only ones who will feel comfortable in this roomtheres a doggie bed and a furry friend, too!', 'By Fisher Price']

2718.title: Barbie Spin 'N Ride Pups(Discontinued by manufacturer)
2718.description: ['Experience the excitement of the new movie Barbie and Her Sisters in The Great Puppy Adventure with this Barbie doll and bicycle set that lets girls create all sorts of motion with simple push movement! With two pets included for the ride, it\'s easy to sniff out adventure. As girls push the riders forward, Barbie doll pedals the bike and the dogs move on their skateboards. To get the action started, place Barbie doll on the bicycle seat and clip her feet and hands into the pedals and handlebars respectively; place Tiffany dog on the big skateboard; and put her puppy on the little one. Then push forward and see them all move. Barbie doll\'s articulated legs appear to pedal while Tiffany dog skateboards forward and the puppy performs spins around Tiffany on its own skateboard to combine realism and fantasy! Barbie doll looks ready for adventure in her "hero" outfit seen in the movie: a floral tunic and silvery pants (non-removable) with black booties and a pink helmet. Barbie doll\'s bicycle is just as stylish designed in pink and blue with silvery handlebars. Girls will love recreating favorite scenes from the film or telling new puppy tales of their own with this fabulous set that captures the adventurous action! Includes Barbie doll wearing fashion and accessories, bicycle with skateboard attachment, Tiffany dog and one puppy. Doll cannot stand alone.']

2775.title: LeapFrog Learning Game: Bubble Guppies
2775.description: ['Splash onto the scene with Gil, Molly and the Bubble Guppies for a fun-filled learning adventure. This innovative LeapFrog Explorer learning game features five curricular mini-games, three bonus games and three activitiesevery level of play is brimming with new discoveries. Discover city places and people, and collect items that belong in a city along the way. Sort recycling and trash, and match animals with their favorite food and habitat. Learning Skills Experience the excitement of visiting new places and meeting new people! Imagine all there is to learn when you dive into a new destinationthe Bubble Guppies have new words and revelations to share with those who play along. Join Molly, Gil, Bubble Puppy and Mr. Grouper on three exciting field tripsto Bubble City to learn about recycling, to a Dinosaur Dig to pick up fossil facts, and to the Puppy Park to discover an animal habitat. Begin to categorize animals by species and pick up fun facts related to their diets and habitats. Learn about dinosaurs, their physical characteristics and recognize that fossils reveal secrets about ancient life forms. Finally, learn about the benefits of recycling and conserving resources. This game helps build listening comprehension skills and is appropriate for children ages 3-5 years. The LeapFrog Difference LeapFrog has created a learning/play environment that is developmentally appropriate for the target age group. Children ages 3-5 interact with screen-based games in ways all their own. Game functionality has been customized to include: preschooler-friendly landscape orientation and intuitive horizontal scrolling; generous tap and touch hot spots to accommodate developing fine motor skills; visually compelling and distinct interactive elements; and the delivery of instantaneous feedback with any child-screen interaction. Recent studies have shown the benefits of integrating content area learning and literacy learningScience and Social Studies topics provide natural contexts for building listening comprehension skills. Innovative Learning Approach Children can be a part of the Bubble Guppies learning environment, discovering social studies and science topics while nurturing their natural curiosity and inquisitiveness. Along the way, children build vocabulary and listening comprehension skills key to early reading as they learn about recycling, animal habitats, fossils and people and places in the community What\'s In The Box? Box includes the LeapFrog Explorer Nickelodeon Bubble Guppies game cartridge (compatible with LeapFrog LeapPad Explorer Learning Tablets, Leapster ExplorerGS and Explorer gaming systemssold separately), Parent Guide & Instruction Book. Take advantage of hundreds of game cartridges and downloads that keep kids challenged and inspired. LeapFrogs library of educational entertainment content includes videos, music, learning games, Ultra eBooks and creative activities. ', 'Discover a watery world of learning and laughter on 3 field trips with Molly, Gil, Bubble Puppy and all your Bubble Guppy friends. As you explore with the class, learn about science and social studies while building listening comprehension skills. Visit the Puppy Park to learn about recycling, Big Bubble City to learn about people and places and a dinosaur dig site to find fossils. Plus, earn Bubble Badges and collect items along the way. Age 3-5 years Features Help the Bubble Guppies clean up the Puppy Park: Sort recycling and trash and match animals with their habitats and foods. As you play, collect Bubble BitesBubble Puppy\'s favorite snack. Then search under shells to find Bubble Puppy\'s ball. Visit Big Bubble City to learn about the people and things you can see in a city and to watch a fin-tastic fireworks celebration. Discover city places and people and collect city items along the way. Then have a blast helping to make as many fireworks sparkle before time runs out. Go on a trip to a dinosaur dig site with Gil and discover facts about the prehistoric world. Help him collect bones and fossils to complete a skeleton and then answer questions to identify, sort and match fossils. When you\'re done collecting, use your memory in a bonus game to match fossils as fast as you can. With 5 curricular mini-games, 3 bonus games and 3 activities, every level of play is packed full of exciting things to discover. Learning Difference "Children can be a part of the Bubble Guppies learning environment, discovering social studies and science topics while nurturing their natural curiosity and inquisitiveness. Along the way, children build vocabulary and listening comprehension skills key to early reading as they learn about recycling, animal habitats, fossils and people and places in the community." Carolyn J., LeapFrog Learning Expert Works with Works with LeapPad2 Explorer, LeapPad1 Explorer, LeapsterGS Explorer and Leapster Explorer (sold separately).']

2811.title: LeapFrog Learning Game: Get Ready for Kindergarten (for LeapPad Ultra, LeapPad1, LeapPad2, Leapster Explorer, LeapsterGS Explorer)
2811.description: [' LeapFrog Learning Game: Get Ready for Kindergarten LeapFrog Get Ready for Kindergarten Game Pack ', 'LeapFrog Get Ready for Kindergarten Game Pack is a suite of titles that teach core skills to help children prepare for starting school. Developed by learning experts for children in pre-K through kindergarten (ages 35 years), Get Ready for Kindergarten features a rich curriculum in reading, math and life skills. Over three fun adventures, children practice letter recognition and number sense skills, and they explore daily routines linked to school success. LeapFrog Get Ready for Kindergarten Game Pack works with all LeapPad learning tablets and Leapster Explorer and LeapsterGS game systems (sold separately).', 'Your childs beloved LeapFrog animal friends are all here, and kids love learning with critters in a classroom! Build reading skills and have a forest full of fun with Sylvie Squirrel, Ozzie Otter, Olive Owl, Spot the Ladybug, Mack and Watson the Moth. Then, go from the classroom to the jungle on a light-hearted, laugh-along skill-building mission with everyones favorite member of the Stretchicus Apeilopicus genus, Stretchy Monkey! Finally, enter the Dragon Caf where two funny dragon puppets impatiently await their dinner. These silly dragons demand more and more fooduntil the bill arrives!', 'Each game personalizes the learning to the child and automatically adjusts the level for just the right challenge. Ozzie and Mack ABCs starts at the appropriate age-based level, and children progress from writing simple letters to complex upper- and lowercase letters. Younger players get hints during gameplay and follow dots that guide letter-writing. At higher levels, they get more distractors and see only outlines of letters. In Counting at the Dragon Caf and Stretchy Monkeys Super Day, children start at level one and advance as they master new skills. They go from tracing curved lines to writing numbers and from matching colorful shapes to completing complex visual analogies.', 'In Ozzie and Mack ABCs, young readers practice literacy skills and explore rhyming, critical thinking and book and print basics. They identify letters while collecting snowflakes and learn to recognize letter sounds while feeding a bug with an alphabetic appetite. In Stretchy Monkeys Super Day, children help Stretchy make his bed and get ready for work and then unpack his bag and get ready for sleep. They also solve logic puzzles and navigate through the jungle to deliver bananas. In Counting at the Dragon Caf, kids use number recognition, number writing and simple counting to serve tasty tidbits to demanding dragons.', 'LeapFrog Get Ready for Kindergarten Game Pack was developed by educational experts to help children build confidence and core competencies for starting school. By helping Mack, Spot and Watson cross the water to reunite with their friends, children learn to differentiate between upper- and lowercase letters. As they swing through the jungle with Stretchy Monkey, children practice solving logic puzzles. When children prepare written receipts for their dragon customers, they level up from tracing shapes to writing one- and two-digit numbers.', 'LeapFrog Get Ready for Kindergarten Game Pack learning game cartridge (compatible with all LeapPad learning tablets and Leapster Explorer and Leapster GS game systems sold separately) and Parent Guide.']

2812.title: LeapFrog Learning Friends: Preschool Adventures Learning Game (for LeapPad3, LeapPad2, LeapPad1, Leapster Explorer, LeapsterGS Explorer)
2812.description: ["LeapFrog Learning Friends: Preschool Adventures helps little ones, ages 3 and 4, get ready for preschool through 3 exciting adventures with the Learning Friends. (Includes Turtle's ABCs!, Tiger Counts! and Monkey Creates!, also sold separately.) Children can dive into literacy skills with Turtle as they have a blast at the beach, use early mathematics to give Tiger a wonderful birthday celebration, and join Monkey for a day of creative fun at the playground. LeapFrog Learning Friends: Preschool Adventures works with all LeapPad tablets and LeapsterGS gaming systems (sold separately). In Turtle's ABCs, little ones spend a day of fun in the sun nurturing skills for reading. They can go snorkeling with Turtle, and help him search for-and identify-upper- and lowercase letters. They can blow bubbles with Koala, and listen to letter sounds as the bubbles grow. A fun crab catching game invites little ones to match letters and then trace the letter-shaped drawing in the sand, while a tide pool game helps build vocabulary. Tiger Counts adds to the learning and fun with a picnic party for Tiger's fourth birthday. Children can help make it her best birthday ever as they use counting skills to set the table, compare the sizes of cake slices to serve everyone dessert, and sort balloons by color, shape and number. In Monkey Creates, little ones join the Learning Friends at the playground to explore gardening with Turtle and play 5 different musical instruments with Tiger. They can also build a tricycle, scooter, wagon or pedal car by dragging vehicle parts onto a blueprint, and help Monkey find shapes in his pictures and chalk drawing. Pick a color and tap a shape to color each picture!"]

2905.title: DreamWorks Trolls Poppy Collectible Figure
2905.description: ['Highly collectible and totally fabulous, this figure features wild, colorful hair with tons of flair! Inspired by the movie, DreamWorks Trolls Poppy is the heroic leader who believes that, with a song in your heart, you can do anything. Style her look with the removable headband, and try to tame her wild and fluffy locks with the included comb. Collect them all! (Each sold separately.) DreamWorks Trolls Copyright 2016 DreamWorks Animation LLC. All rights reserved. Hasbro and all related terms are trademarks of Hasbro.']

2906.title: DreamWorks Trolls Poppy's Coronation Pod
2906.description: ['DreamWorks Trolls Poppy is the heroic leader, lifting the spirits of everyone around her with positivity and the belief that, with a song in your heart, you can do anything! Join in on the fun with this fabulous playset, featuring a magical dance floor that lights up and spins. The playset comes with 2 figures: DreamWorks Trolls Poppy and Branch. Change her outfit with the 2 removable dresses, and all of the 11 accessories that are fit for a princess party! DreamWorks Trolls Copyright 2016 DreamWorks Animation LLC. All rights reserved. Hasbro and all related terms are trademarks of Hasbro.']

2907.title: Ideal War Card Game
2907.description: ['Ideal War Card Game pits dogs vs. cats in this classic card game! Each oversized card (4.5in. x 3in.) has an adorable image of a dog or cat and a value from 2 to Ace. All cards are shuffled together and 2 players go head to head, turning their cards over hoping to have the higher value. The higher card wins the round, unless its a tiethen its WAR! Each player lays down 4 cards and the winner takes all! The game is over when one player has all of the cards. Includes a deck of 52 cards and instructions. Recommended for children 4 years of age and older.']

2908.title: Ideal 40-Trick Magic Show Kit
2908.description: ['Ideal 40 Trick Magic Show Kit contains everything your little magician needs to put on a mysterious magic show! The tricks theyll learn in this set are a great introduction to the fun and exciting art form known as magic! Includes 4 fuzzy balls, 3 cups, 1 magic mystery deck of cards, 1 thumb tip, 1 levitation tool and an instruction sheet. Some common household item are required. Recommended for children 7 years of age and older.']

2909.title: Wilson US Open Junior Tennis Racquet
2909.description: ['Wilson is the Official Ball of the US Open and partner of the USTA. The US Open 19 inch Junior Tennis Racket is approved for 10 and Under Tennis and is extremely lightweight and easy to swing.']

2910.title: DC Super Hero Girls Super Hero High School Playset
2910.description: ['This Super Hero High School playset and Batgirl action figure -- inspired by DC Super Hero Girls -- brings the adventures of the powerful teen Super Heroes to life! Three action features offer tons of opportunity for these Super Heroes to fly, climb and zipline into action. Take flight with the mechanism around the top of the school\'s tower. Attach up to three DC Super Hero Girls action figures (other figures sold separately) to the tower clips and turn the "amethyst" that tops the tower to see them fly around it. The storytelling possibilities are limitless! When it\'s time to land, keep the action going. Head down to the first floor via two ziplines, one of them customizable! Use the suction cup to attach the second zipline, using suction, to a surface -- you can even use it to attach and go from the second floor all the way to the first. Get back up with the grappling hook -- simply attach the Batgirl figure doll at the wrist to see her climb. The doll is highly articulated so she can perform all kinds of moves to save the day. The Super Hero teen is ready to practice her powers wearing a unique purple bodysuit with black sleeves, high neck and tall yellow boots. Her signature bat symbol adorns the bodice and backpack. Send her up and down to class, to train and to practice her powers. The DC Super Hero Girls play set has classic schoolrooms, too. There\'s a cafeteria, a classroom and a locker for Batgirl that holds a removable helmet inside. Accessories add to the action with realistic touches -- a classroom desk, cafeteria table and lunch trays expand the play opportunity. Go from Super Hero training to Super Hero hanging to Super Hero adventures. Soar into storytelling, find your own unique abilities and discover your true potential along with the Super Hero teens of DC Super Hero High! Includes Batgirl action figure, DC Super Hero High school play set and accessories that include a helmet, desk, cafeteria table, lunch trays and plates. Colors and decorations may vary.', 'By DC Comics']

2911.title: Buzz Bee Toys Air Warriors Tek 4 Blaster Two Pack
2911.description: ['Buzz Bee Toys Air Warriors Tek 4 Blaster Two Pack lets you and a friend hit 4 targets without having to reload. Just pull back on the clip, then pull the trigger to hit your target up to 30 feet away. Manually turn the barrel and youre ready to launch your next dart. The set includes 2 dart blasters, 8 soft foam suction darts and cut out target. Recommended for children 6 years of age and older.']

2912.title: Toy State Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Raphael's Ooze Booster Light and Sound Vehicle
2912.description: ["Who's ready to raise some shell? Press the button and watch as it speeds forward, pops a wheelie and reveals a super-charged ooze rocket! Featuring exciting music, fighting sounds and vocals."]

2913.title: Fisher-Price Think & Learn Spell & Speak Sea Turtle
2913.description: ['Fisher-Price Think & Learn Spell & Speak Sea Turtle']

2914.title: Disney/Pixar Cars Flag Finish Lightning McQueen Toy Car
2914.description: ['Participate in the champion\'s competitive action with Flag Finish Lightning McQueen! Disney/Pixar Cars fans can get revved and ready to race in 3 different ways: with drag and drift stunting action, braving laps at the Piston Cup, and celebrating with a victory dance! The hotrod vehicle also says over 80 iconic phrases and sounds, like "Ka-chow!" and "I love being me!" The flag controls all the action so you\'re in charge! With Flag Finish Lightning McQueen, your favorite racing thrills comes to life. Requires 6 AA alkaline batteries for vehicle and 2 AAA alkaline batteries for transmitter (flag). Batteries not included. Colors and decorations may vary.', 'By Cars']

2915.title: Mega Bloks Call of Duty Desert Tank Collector Construction Set
2915.description: ['Build the Call of Duty Desert Tank collector construction set by Mega Bloks. Theres no stopping the advance as Captain John Price and his team storm ahead with the Desert Tank! Combining heavy defenses with powerful artillery, this buildable desert camo tank comes ready to deal out the devastation with a rotating gun turret and missile launcher. Open the turret, cockpit, and troop bay hatches to load your team of three highly detailed, super poseable soldiers into the tank. Then, gear them for the mission using the detachable armor and authentic weapons and accessories, and roll out as you ready your team for the bombardment!']

2916.title: Mega Construx Kubros Despicable Me Minion Building Kit
2916.description: ["It's an 8-Bit invasion when you build and collect your favorite pop-culture icons with Kubros! Now you can build your own Kevin Minion figure block by block, complete with iconic details drawn from the original Despicable Me character. Featuring the signature goggles, overalls, and mischievous smile, this collectible figure brings it back to the old school with a blocky shape and retro-fied design inspired by the era of classic gaming. With its signature coin detail on the foot, and arms and head that move, you can pose your Kevin different ways for a showcase-worthy display. Collect all your favorite characters from movies, video games and more, and build your fandom with Kubros! Ideal for ages 10 and up"]

2917.title: Pictionary Man Double Draw Game
2917.description: ['Pictionary Man just doubled the fun! This version of the beloved Pictionary game includes game pieces and ways to play. Split into two teamseach team gets its own Pictionary Man to draw on. Youngest player gets to choose between All Play and Pictionary Pairs, and the first team to guess the clue before the sand timer runs out wins the card! In All Play, both teams share the same clue. In Pictionary Pairs, each team draws one part of a paired clue (Bride & Groom, Cops & Robbers). Winning team guesses the entire phrase! First team to win three of each type of card (All Play and Pictionary Pairs) wins the game. Comes with two Pictionary men, two shapes (box, ball), four paddles to draw on, 150 clue cards, timer, markers, and more. Ages 8 and older. You dont have to be an artistPictionary is a blast for everyone!', 'By Mattel Games']

2918.title: Maisto R/C Cyklone 360 Black Police Radio Control Motorcycle Bike
2918.description: ['Maisto Tech Street Series Futuristic style radio control motorcycle with amazing spinning action. Buy 2 and play with your friends in a head to head battle. Available in orange and black police styles. Changing-color LED gives a futuristic glow while the bike is on. The operator controls the rear wheel angle to make the Cyklone 360 steer. Click on the video to see the wild spinning stunts that are easy enough for a child to quickly master.']

2919.title: Green Toys Train Off The Rails with Kody & Dot Book
2919.description: ['', 'Train off the Rails with Kody & Dot, a Green Toys Storybook', 'Kody and Dot drive a delivery train around the same loop, every single day. Then one day, their train jumps the tracks, and they discover a whole new way of looking at their jobs! Join the two bears as they discover just how big their world is.', 'With vibrant artwork and fun, rhyming text, this book will have little train lovers recreating the action with their Green Toys long after story time is over.', 'Train off the Rails is a storybook designed to accompany a toy train set, but the book is anything but an afterthought, standing on its own as a wry statement about exceeding limitations. BlueInk, starred review', 'preschoolers who love picture books about vehicles should be thrilled with all the different types featured here. Kirkus']

2920.title: Green Toys Mixed-Up Trucks with Baxter, Rosie & Gus Book
2920.description: ['', 'Mixed-Up Trucks with Baxter, Rosie and Gus, a Green Toys Storybook', 'Baxter, Rosie and Gus were born to drive trucks. But soon they learn that the only way to get things done is to work together, or what a mess they will have! Join the three dogs as they discover just how fun cooperation can be.', 'With vibrant artwork and fun, rhyming text, this book will have little truck lovers recreating the action with their Green Toys long after story time is over.']

2921.title: Green Toys Boats Built for Speed with Davey & Pearl Book
2921.description: ['', 'Boats Built for Speed with Davey and Pearl, a Green Toys Storybook', 'Davey and Pearl deliver boxes across the lake. But business is booming, and they need to move the boxes faster and faster! Come along as the two ducks discover that sometimes you have to slow down and make a plan if speed is what you need.', 'With vibrant artwork and fun, rhyming text, this book will have little boat lovers recreating the action with their own toys long after story time is over.']

2922.title: Lil Lockitz Selfie Set
2922.description: ['Lil Lockitz Selfie Set by ALEX Toys lets you express yourself as never before to create something truly personal, for yourself or a loved one. Lil Lockitz supplies you with gems, backgrounds and charms of your favorite things to float in a wearable collage that tells a story. Capture your favorite day, your favorite activity or even your favorite person! Theres no better way to personalize a locket than with your own picture. The easy photo puncher crops your selfie to the perfect size. Just fill it with custom charms, gems and letters, lock it up when everything is in place and wear it as a necklace for everybody to see. The set comes with everything you need to make 2 Lockitz! Includes 2 Locket Tops, 2 Locket Backs, 2 Necklaces, 8 Charms, 6 Gems, 4 Backgrounds, Sequin Letters, Photo Puncher, Photo Stencil, Locket Crimper and Easy Instructions. Recommended for children 5 years of age and older.']

2923.title: Lil Lockitz Best Friend Party Pack
2923.description: ["Lil' Lockitz Best Friend Party Pack by ALEX Toys lets you express yourself as never before to create something truly personal, for yourself or a loved one. Lil Lockitz supplies you with gems, backgrounds and charms of your favorite things to float in a wearable collage that tells a story. This set Is EVERYTHING! Get all of your BFFs over and dive into this super deluxe kit! Make lockets for yourselves or each other. Show everyone what you have in common or what makes you unique! Just fill it with custom charms of things you love, lock it up when everything is in place and wear it as a necklace, bracelet or use the Keychain Clasps to make clip-ons! The set comes with everything you need to make 18 Lockitz! Includes 18 Locket Tops, 18 Locket Backs, 6 Necklaces, 6 Bracelets, 6 Keychain Clasps, 72 Charms, 54 Gems, 32 Backgrounds, 1 Pack of Sequin Letters, Tweezers, Photo Stencil, Locket Crimper, Photo Puncher, Storage Tray and Easy Instructions. Recommended for children 5 years of age and older."]

2924.title: VS Rip-Spin Warriors Twin Tornado Arena
2924.description: ['Take the ultimate faceoff to the next level inside the VS Rip-Spin Warriors Twin Tornado Arena! With the dual spiral overhead launcher and two configurable dual battle launchers, you can create the most epic battles for total spin-sanity! Just place the VS Rip-Spin Warriors in the two ramp launchers, pull the rip cords to activate the flywheels, press the safe start button to launch them down each spiral zipline and into the arena at the same time. You can also place two VS Warriors in each dual launcher, thread one zip cord in each launcher, and press the button to shoot two launchers into battle sending four warriors into battle. Twin Tornado Arena allows you to battle up to six VS Warriors at once! See whos knocked out first and battle in all-new ways with stunting action. Theres no limit to the spin-sanity! The Twin Tornado Arena includes dual spiral overhead launcher, two configurable dual battler launchers, two exclusive VS Warriors and large connectable battle arena. Collect all the arenas to build the ultimate VS Rip-Spin Warriors world. Each arena sold separately, subject to availability. Colors and decorations may vary.', 'By Mattel']

2925.title: Fisher-Price Grow-to-Pro Super Sounds Soccer
2925.description: ['This fun soccer set rewards developing skills as kids grow. Beginners score fun sounds each time they hit the net. With the big goal net, soccer newbies are sure to score some confidence, too! More advanced players have to hit the target to hear the announcer shout Gooaalll! Add to the challenge by moving the adjustable target anywhere along the goal post. And what better way to learn than with a friend? The adjustable target can keep score for two players!', 'Fisher-Price: For the Best Possible Start. To give your child the best possible start in life, you dont have to have all the answers or do things a certain way. All you have to do is the best you can, and let your kids play. At Fisher-Price, were dedicated to helping you do just that by working tirelessly to bring you the very best gear and toys. Fisher-Price toys are made to help all kidsfrom infants to toddlers to preschoolersdevelop through play, in their own ways, because thats how they learn best at each age and stage. And for babies, our gear offers simple solutions (more sleep, anyone?!) you cant possibly parent without.']

2926.title: Thin Air Brands Tangle-Free Parachute with Paratrooper in Reusable Storage Tube, Multicolor (Set of 4)
2926.description: ["Throw it, drop it, toss it for hours of fun! Kids of all ages love playing with this super high quality paratrooper. The parachute is tangle-free meaning no more un-tying knots. The silk nylon chute is light weight and floats smoothly. The paratrooper is made of high quality water proof plastic. And, comes packed in a reusable tube with lid. Makes for a great gift, you'll want more than one! Available in attractive colors. Great for boys and girls of all ages. Assorted colors. Colors will vary. SET OF 4!."]

2927.title: Ravensburger Buggaloop Board Game
2927.description: ["Look out! There's a HEXBUG in the yard and it's coming after you! Players take turns rolling the die and moving their bugs across the yard, until the HEXBUG emerges from the tunnel and tries to bump them off. Stay standing and continue down your path - get bumped and you'll have to start from the beginning again! The first player to transport all of their bugs to safety wins this surprising buggy scramble! How to Play: 1. Roll the die and move one of your bugs the corresponding number of spaces. 2. Watch out for the HEXBUG! If he bumps your bug off of a space, return to start. 3. The first player to move all of his bugs to safety wins the game."]

2928.title: Mega Bloks American Girl Isabelle's Ballet Recital Construction Set
2928.description: ["Isabelle's Ballet Stage- It's time to draw back the curtain on Isabelle's Ballet Recital by Mega Bloks American Girl and put on the perfect performance! Help her get started by building the dress rehearsal area where Isabelle can design and create costumes at her buildable sewing station! Next it's time to build the ballet bar, where she and her friend Luisa can practice their plies! Now that they're ready to perform, build center stage and have the girls perform a dazzling dance duet! The stage also features a spinning floor so that you can display all of the girls' polished positions and poses! Bravo! Encore! Ideal for ages 8 years and older."]

2929.title: Fisher-Price DHC27 Laugh & Learn Let's Get Ready Sink Baby Toy
2929.description: ['Lets get ready for the day with a fun toddler play sink to inspire role play! Turn the sink knobs, pump the soap bottle, or remove the toothbrush, toothpaste and comb to hear songs and phrases that teach toddlers about daily routines, familiar objects, colors, letters and more. The sink bowl lights up too, when toddlers turn the red and blue sink knobs. Curious toddlers will love peeking into the shiny mirror. And a removable, soft washcloth adds to the realistic, good, clean fun! Every toddler learns & plays in different ways. Smart Stages technology lets you select the stage thats best for your child on any given day! Switch up the level to switch up the learning fun, and offer up a different variety of phrases, songs & sounds for your little one! Smart Stages Technology Level 1 - Learn. Fun phrases teach colors, objects & daily routines. Level 2 - Engage. Simple questions prompt your little one to find items around the sink. Level 3 - Imagine. Fun songs about healthy routines encourage early role play.', 'By Fisher Price']

2930.title: Hasbro Disney Princess Ariel's Royal Ribbon Salon
2930.description: ["With Ariel's Royal Ribbon Salon, your little dreamer can create stylish hair extensions using colorful ribbons for her favorite Little Mermaid! Ariel sits in her special salon chair while your child styles her hair. Simply put the ribbon in the spinner, turn the handle, and watch as it transforms to look like hair! The Salon also comes with a variety of ribbons and hair clips that can be mixed and matched to create the perfect enchanted look! Copyright Disney Hasbro and all related terms are trademarks of Hasbro."]

2931.title: Disney Elena of Avalor and Skylar 2-Pack
2931.description: ['', "Meet Elena of Avalor, the adventurous Crown Princess, and her loyal friend Skylar, a magical talking jaquin. This 2-pack includes an Elena of Avalor fashion doll and a Skylar figure with large, vibrant wings that really flap when your little adventurer moves him up and down! The Elena of Avalor doll clips onto Skylar's back so girls can play out their favorite magical adventures from the Disney Channel TV series and imagine the two friends roaming the skies of Avalor defending the kingdom against all who threaten it!"]

2932.title: Fisher-Price Grow-to-Pro Junior Basketball
2932.description: ['They shoot, they score! Toddlers start with the Sure Score rim, which does more than just guide the ball into the basket, it helps build their confidence! When kids are ready for more of a challenge, just remove the special rim. Four height positions make this basketball set a real slam dunk it grows with little b-ballers and their shooting skills!', 'Fisher-Price: For the Best Possible Start. To give your child the best possible start in life, you dont have to have all the answers or do things a certain way. All you have to do is the best you can, and let your kids play. At Fisher-Price, were dedicated to helping you do just that by working tirelessly to bring you the very best gear and toys. Fisher-Price toys are made to help all kidsfrom infants to toddlers to preschoolersdevelop through play, in their own ways, because thats how they learn best at each age and stage. And for babies, our gear offers simple solutions (more sleep, anyone?!) you cant possibly parent without.']

2933.title: The Secret Life of Pets Scra-ffiti Pad
2933.description: ["The Secret Life of Pets Scra-ffiti lets artists create beautiful colored designs based on Illumination's Pets characters! With special paper, the Scra-ffiti book is made so that when you draw with the wooden stylus, the top layer of the paper scratches away, revealing a rainbow of colors underneath! Practice different scratching techniques for cool effects. The book contains 10 adorable pages featuring Max, Chloe, Mel and more, plus a wooden stylus. Recommended for children 5 years of age and older."]

2934.title: Marvel Captain America: Civil War Slide Blast Armor
2934.description: ['Launch into battle like Iron Man! With the Slide Blast Armor, kids can push a button to send armor up their arm and armor up just like Iron Man! Pull the lever on the gauntlet, then push the button a second time to fire NERF darts! With the Iron Man Slide Blast Armor, kids can imagine joining the battle to save humanity alongside one of the most technologically advanced Super Heroes in the Marvel Universe! Copyright 2015 Marvel. Hasbro and all related terms are trademarks of Hasbro.']

2935.title: Squinkies Squinkieville Clubhouse Playset
2935.description: ["Everyone's favorite Squinkieville hangout! Relax in the game room, snack in the Squinkie Cafe, or try on your favorite 'Do in the dress up room! The Clubhouse is loaded with cute and quirky features! Try the spinning lookout, chill on the two seat swing, or peek into the hidden compartment under the Clubhouse floor! Best of all, the Clubhouse comes with three exclusive Squinkies and an exclusive 'Do for them to wear."]

2936.title: Schleich Horse Club Riding Center with Accessories Set
2936.description: ['Run your own stable and take care of your own horses without the expenses! This stable play set comes with everything you need for an authentic horse farm experience. Accessories include: horse feed, grooming supplies, mucking supplies, tack, and the structures to build a stable and riding arena! Since each accessory is crafted out of high quality plastic, they will endure hours of playtime! This set makes the perfect gift for any horse lover out there.']

2937.title: ALEX Toys Craft Sk8 Deck Wall Art Street Sk8ter
2937.description: ['ALEX Toys Craft Sk8 Deck Wall Art Street Sk8ter is the most fun you can have with a skateboard without leaving the house. The real, mini-skateboard deck measures 17.25in. long x 5.25in. wide and is made of wood which is finished with a colorable surface on one side and unfinished on the other. Street Sk8ter features graffiti themed artwork which is a combination of very cute and very cool. 6 brightly colored markers are included as well as a bracket to display your artwork standing on a shelf or hanging from a wall. Recommended for children 6 years of age and older.']

2938.title: The Secret Life of Pets 3D Fabric Snowball
2938.description: ['The Secret Life of Pets 3D Fabric Snowball by ALEX Toys is your chance to create an adorable character from the movie and adopt it as your own! Build Snowball, the fluffy bunny, and keep him happy, safe and out of trouble (please, keep him out of trouble). Attach plush and fluff fabric pieces to the Styrofoam body, then add on details like eyes, nose, ears and more and your pet is ready to be pet! Includes a 4in. tall Styrofoam mold, plastic tool, 5 precut felt pieces, 2 plastic eyes and nose, bag of cut fabric (1.5oz.) and easy instructions. Recommended for children 5 years of age and older.']

2939.title: Play-Doh Town 3-in-1 Town Center
2939.description: ["Come on down and create epic adventures in Play-Doh Town! Check out the best spot on the block for Play-Doh Town citizens to stop, shop, and have fun. Create everything from the clock tower, to the figures' hairstyles, to the local birds hanging out on the rooftops! Before the citizens go on a downtown drive, stop at the mechanic shop to make custom hubcaps and other automotive details. Don't forget to squeeze out a silly beard for the mechanic and some Play-Doh gasoline for the car! Next, cruise on over to the restaurant to make Play-Doh dinners, wacky snacks, and make-believe desserts. But this isn't any ordinary restaurant - slide the table back, press the stamp, and pop out a pretend pizza or cake! Stop at the florist to create some beautiful bouquets and delightful decorations to brighten up the downtown area. With so many ways to create and customize the Play-Doh Town Center again and again, there's no telling what kinds of surprising, creative, and hilarious things will happen next! Hasbro, Play-Doh and all related properties are trademarks of Hasbro."]

2940.title: Zootopia Police Station Playset
2940.description: ['The Zootopia Police Station is the headquarters for all ZPD officers. It\'s where Judy Hopps gets her assignments, where Chief Bogo\'s office is, and where Clawhauser eats his donuts. This large playset comes with 3" Clawhauser Figure that features poseable arms, neck, and legs, a 1" safety squirrel that fits into the included mouse Helicopter. A projector simulates a computer monitor with three images, and the Police Station comes to life with lights and sounds of sirens and dispatch announcements and the sliding elevators create multi-level play. Get ready for jailbreak action as the sirens sound and the jail door flies open!.']

2941.title: POOF Sidewalk Chalks Surfboards
2941.description: ['POOF Sidewalk Chalk Surfboards is a rad way to decorate your walkway. Each piece of chalk contains 2 colors and is shaped to remind you of the coolest summertime activity, surfing! Play hopscotch, tic-tac-toe or even draw a picture, the sidewalks and driveways are your canvas! Includes 4 pieces of washable, bright, shaped chalk. Recommended for children 3 years of age and older.']

2942.title: POOF Sidewalk Chalks Glow Chalk
2942.description: ['POOF Sidewalk Chalks Glow Chalk is a fantastic way to keep your sidewalk art and messages visible at night! Play games or draw pictures during the day, then come back later and watch them glow. Use with colored chalk to leave secret nighttime messages. When the glowing stops, light the images with a flashlight to recharge! Includes three 3.75in. tall x.75in. diameter chalks that glow in the dark. Recommended for children 3 years of age and older.']

2943.title: Fisher-Price Imaginext Power Rangers Command Center
2943.description: ["What does it take to defeat Goldar and Rita? This super-cool Imaginext Power Rangers Command Center playset is a great place to start! Turn a Power Pad to light up Zordon and start planning your next mission. Place the Power Rangers figures in their harnesses and move a switch back & forth to have them train for battle with one another. Now it's time to save the universe! Turn the second Power Pad to reveal a hidden cannon. Aim it at the enemy and press a button to fire! Once you've captured the bad guys, put them in the jail cell. (Additional figures sold separately.) Kids will use this awesome Imaginext playset and the power of their imaginations to create one Morphinominal adventure after another! Imaginext. Turn on Adventure!"]

2944.title: POOF Sidewalk Chalks Gems
2944.description: ['POOF Sidewalk Chalks Gems is a classy way to make your sidewalk art and messages stand out! Play games or draw pictures in the sunshine and watch them sparkle. 4 different colors of chalk have glitter mixed in to guarantee whatever you draw will twinkle in the sunlight. Includes 4 jewel shaped chalks with glitter. Recommended for children 3 years of age and older.']

2945.title: Franklin Sports Electronic Basketball Bounce A Bucket Arcade Game
2945.description: ['The Franklin Sports Electronic Bounce-A-Bucket has durable frame construction and easily folds for travel or storage. Simply bounce the mini basketball off the trampoline target and the LED electronic digital scoring and in-game play by play sounds gives it an arcade feel. Includes (2) mini basketballs and is 21"x 11" x 19".']

2946.title: My Little Pony Guardians of Harmony Fan Series Discord Figure
2946.description: ['The My Little Pony Friendship is Magic Guardians of Harmony Fan Series figures are sculpted true to entertainment and provide fans with iconic characters in eye-catching detail. Inspired by season 2, episode 2 of the My Little Pony series, this 11-inch My Little Pony Guardians of Harmony Fan Series sculpture captures the humorous, chaotic essence of Discord. Hes featured sitting on a removable throne with legs crossed, enjoying a cup of hot chocolate in one hand with an inside-out umbrella in the other. In fan-series fashion, this Guardians of Harmony Discord sculpture is presented in collectible packaging. Also look for the Guardians of Harmony Fan Series 8-inch Princess Celestia and Nightmare Moon collectibles. (Sold separately. Subject to availability.) My Little Pony and all related characters are trademarks of Hasbro.', 'By My Little Pony']

2947.title: Franklin Sports 2-in-1 Basketball Set
2947.description: ["Franklin's 2-in-1 Basketball puts the fun & excitement of Basketball into two Great game options! the durable plastic backboard is perfect for increased playability. This 2-in-1 easily converts in seconds from a floor standing Basketball set into a door hanging unit. Grab your set today and have some fun."]

2948.title: The Secret Life of Pets Knot-A Pillow
2948.description: ["The Secret Life of Pets Knot-A Pillow by ALEX Toys lets you create a 15in. square pillow of your favorite pet, Max! Just knot the edges, stuff the center and you'll create a bright blue pillow to stitch on the details of Max's face. Perfect for naps or to lay on when binge watching your favorite cartoons! Includes 2 square fleece pillow shapes, 5 colors of embroidery floss, 27 felt shapes, stuffing, 2 needles and instructions. Recommended for children 8 years of age and older."]

2949.title: BRIO Deluxe Birthday Train
2949.description: ["Create a birthday tradition from 1 to 6 with this premium colorful train set. Includes two wagons, six wooden age blocks and a wooden candle. BRIO creates innovative, high-quality and well-designed toys with clean, simple designs that spark children's creativity and imagination while encouraging and supporting each stage of their development. For over a century, our mission has been to create happy childhood memories. All wooden parts are made from 100% FSC-certified beech wood from sustainably managed forests and are built to last for generations."]

2950.title: reCAP Kids EXPLORE Bug Catcher, Firefly Mason Jar, Glow Blue
2950.description: ['The first ever glow-in-the-dark, magnifying Mason jar bug catcher! Explorers can easily view, catch, and release critters with the Bug Catchers magnifying Mason jar lid with breathing holes.The magnifying cap comes with a safe, lightweight, and flexible replaceable plastic jar and a convenient carrying handle. Also included is a free reCAP EXPLORE Activity Book download to inspire learning and adventure!', ' For the beach ', 'Get ready for a summer of discovery with EXPLORE! Get an up-close look at sea shells, dragonflies, and seaweed with the worlds first glow-in- the-dark, magnifier for Mason jars!', 'Schools out, but the summer adventure is just beginning! 2951.title: Adora Mixxie Mermaid Plush Play Animal with Interchangeable pieces & accessories for fun creative motor skill building Age 4+
2951.description: ['Mixxie Mermaid has 9 unique, brightly colored interchangeable pieces to inspire creative play while teaching fine motor skills. Hours of fun and Play is just a button away with this set which includes; 1 doll body, 2 button on/off legs, 2 button on/off arms, 1 button on/off mermaid tail, 1 tutu, 1 decorative hair tie, 1 shell charm necklace']

2952.title: Oball Go Grippers Dump Truck
2952.description: ["Oball has done it again. A dump truck made of that one-of-a-kind grippable, signature material from Oball that's easy to pick up and impossible to put down. The Go Grippers Dump Truck has an Oball cover that opens and closes and makes it fun to transport toys under the Oball dome. The truck bed locks so baby can lock little fingers in the holes and carry it around. Tires make it roll with ease and this little dump truck will carry your child's imagination to new heights. It's time to get a grip on playtime."]

2953.title: Littlest Pet Shop Pet Shop Playset
2953.description: ['There are so many places to play, and kids can display up to 30 pets in this exciting playset! Fun features include a two-story tree slide, paw-shaped swing, doggie doors to go through, a swirling fun hamster ball ride and teetering seesaw. Place up to 30 pets (includes 1 pet and 2 pet friends; additional pets each sold separately) all over for a fun-filled display of any Littlest Pet Shop collection, starting with the included pets, a glittery spaniel (Nutmeg Dash #295), mouse (Noggle Murino #296), and bluebird (Balmy Azure #297). Also includes emoji bubble, Deco Bits, and stickers for storytelling fun. Kids can bring their pets to life in the LPS Your World app*. Once the app is launched, simply hold the pet and scan the code to unlock it in the game! Play activities, track a collection or favorite pets to collect, and complete goals to earn rewards, all while decorating and designing the coolest Littlest Pet Shop world, digitally! *Available at least through June 30, 2018. App works with select iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, and Android devices. Updates affect compatibility. Check littlestpetshop.com for details. In-app purchases enhance game play. Not available in all languages/countries. Website not intended for Quebec residents under 13. Littlest Pet Shop and all related characters are trademarks of Hasbro.']

2954.title: Queen Games Push a Monster Game
2954.description: ["Finally, they can tease the other monsters by every trick in the monster book: They push, squeeze, tear each other and sometimes even swat a little bit -it's monstrous fun for everybody! Push-?a-?Monster is a monster-?strong pushing game with a clever game mechanism and a fascinating 3D setup. CONTENTS: 1 monster arena; 27 wooden monsters; 2 monster pushers; 81 monster tiles; 1 die; 1 sticker sheet; 1 rules booklet."]

2955.title: Barbie Spin Art Designer with Doll Blonde
2955.description: ["Create your own designs and let the fashion designer in you shine with the Barbie Spin Art Designer. Select your fashion, pick your paint colors and spin a new and unique design for Barbie doll! Young designers will love the fun of expressing their creative side and watching their ideas come to life. Every outcome will be different, and, with washable fashions, you can wash out a design and start all over for endless creative expression. Designing is easy. Choose one of three included washable dresses, and place it on the dress form. Different colors and trendy silhouettes provide options for numerous looks and styles. Attach the dress form to the spin art unit and close the pink lid. Select one of the three paint colors (pink, yellow and blue paints are included) and shake the bottle up. Pump the lever on the spin art unit to make it spin, and add paint drops through the holes on the unit's lid as it spins. Continue to pump the lever to allow the paint color to spread in cool and fun ways. Once you're happy with the amount of paint you've added, open the lid to reveal your custom-designed dress. Spin a little or a lot. Choose one paint color or all three. You decide because you're the designer! Dress the included Barbie doll in your fabulous spin art fashion and black booties that complement any style. Create fabulous looks to play out your own stories or display your designs. Young creative will enjoy the endless expression and storytelling possibilities because with Barbie, you can be anything! Includes Barbie doll wearing one washable fashion and shoes, the spin art unit, one dress form, two additional washable fashions and three bottles of paint. Doll cannot stand alone. Colors and decorations may vary."]

2956.title: VTech Go! Go! Smart Wheels Launch and Go Ride On (Frustration Free Packaging)
2956.description: ['Go for a drive with the Go! Go! Smart Wheels Launch and Go Ride On by VTech. This 2-in-1 ride-on toy lets your little one become a race car driver as they scoot across the floor. Twist the key, turn the wheel or press the buttons to hear realistic race car sounds, encouraging phrases and more. When theyve reached their destination, your child can transform the ride on into an exciting speedway for the included SmartPoint race car. Launch the car down the ramp and through the tunnel to hear the playset respond with fun phrases or put it on the three SmartPoint locations her hear more sounds and phrases. Find fun fast with this exciting 2-in-1 toy. Requires 4 AAA batteries - 2 for the Ride On and 2 for the SmartPoint vehicle (batteries included for demo purposes only; new batteries recommended for regular use). Intended for ages 1 to 3 years.']

2957.title: Skip Hop Bandana Buddies Soft Activity Puppet Book, Elephant
2957.description: ['A soft book and hand puppet in one. Recognizing that families love products that multitask, we created a 2-in-1 toy that\'s full of surprises. You can "read" it like a book, play with it as a hand puppet, or let baby grab it and use it as a tether. Each page offers engaging textures, patterns and sounds, with activities including a baby-safe mirror, peek-a-boo windows, crinkle fabric and squeakers. A multisensory way to multitask. Ages 0+; Soft book and hand puppet in one; Book has 3D cover and three interior pages filled with textures, patterns and sounds; Activities include: baby-safe mirror, peek-a-boo windows, crinkle fabric and squeakers; Two teething surfaces include plastic bandana and a hanging tether to match animal theme; Top loop for hanging or on-the-go transport; Available in Puppy, Monkey and Elephant; Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, no bleach. Tumble dry; BPA-free & Phthalate-free; Size (inches): 6.5l x 1w x 6.5h; (cm): 17l x 3w x 17h', 'By Skip Hop']

2958.title: Schleich North America Cow Family On The Pasture Toy Figure
2958.description: ["Cows love being on the pasture because then they can graze peacefully all day long. Needless to say, this makes them very thirsty too. That's why the farmer regularly fills the big tanker with fresh water and drives it over to the animals. When it's empty, she tows it away with the tractor and refills it. After a lovely day on the pasture, the farmer drives the cows to the milking machine in the livestock building in the evening and fills milk cans with fresh milk."]

2959.title: K’NEX – Mighty Makers Runway Designer Building Set – 119 Pieces – Ages 7+ Construction Education Toy
2959.description: ['', "Enhance your kids' creativity with the K'NEX Mighty Makers Runway Designer Building Set. This toy set incorporates traditional construction play with the STEAM concept of design. Children will enjoy creating various design studio models using the 119 colorful K'NEX pieces.", 'Mighty Makers also includes two plastic figures – Audrey, the designer, and Lacey, her cat. Kids get to learn more about the tools used in fashion with the help of the additional accessories: a hat, sewing machine, scissors, French curve, dress stand, camera, tripod, and extra outfit pieces. This building set is a great toy for children ages 7 and up, as it teaches them about design and geometry.', 'Each package comes with an easy-to-follow instruction booklet and a card that guides your designers as they construct a design studio, fashion runway, and curved ruler for making dress patterns. This fun activity subtly enhances STEAM (science, technology, engineering, arts, and math) subjects to children. It also strengthens their hand-eye coordination, fine motor skills, problem-solving skills, and spatial awareness and hones their analytical skills and critical-thinking abilities.', "With K'NEX, children engage in real-world learning at an early age. Numerous studies reveal that kids have more success in learning STEAM concepts through hands-on activities than by reading about abstract concepts in textbooks. Kids are introduced to architecture and experience what it's like to be a real architect as they use the construction blueprint instruction booklet.", "K'NEX offers only high-quality educational toys proudly made in the U.S. in Hatfield, Pennsylvania. Responsible manufacturing techniques are used, and toys are tested to the strictest quality and safety standards, guaranteeing a lifetime of fun and entertainment.", "Enrich your children's creativity and foster their psychological growth with K'NEX Mighty Makers Runway Designer Building Set.", "By K'Nex"]

2960.title: POOF Sidewalk Chalks Beach Fun
2960.description: ["POOF Sidewalk Chalk Beach Fun is a sunny way to decorate your walkway. Each piece of chalk contains 2 colors and is shaped like everyone's favorite summertime footwear, a flip flop and beach balls. Play hopscotch, tic-tac-toe or even draw a picture, the sidewalks and driveways are your canvas! Includes 4 pieces of washable, bright, shaped chalk. Recommended for children 3 years of age and older."]

2961.title: Barbie 2016 Holiday Doll
2961.description: ['A beloved tradition for more than 25 years, the 2016 Holiday Barbie doll rings in the wonder of the holidays and all the joyous festivities. Dressed in a beautiful blue ombre sparkle skirt with detailed bodice and bracelet, Holiday Barbie doll has the perfect glamorous look that will shine bright all season long. Specially designed packaging is ideal for gift-giving and sure to make 2016 Holiday Barbie a treasured keepsake for years to come. Happy holidays! For ages 6 and over.']

2962.title: Crayola; Crayon Factory; Art Tool; Electronic; Melt and Mold Crayon Bits into Custom Creations
2962.description: ['Watch your colorful crayon bits transform into custom creations! Use the included crayons, or recycle your old Crayola crayon bits to make marvelous melted creations with the electronic Crayon Factory! Simply mix, melt and mold to make colorful car, heart and puppy crayons for playing and doodling!']

2963.title: Adora Doll Accessories Portable Table Feeding Seat for Children 3 years and up
2963.description: ['The Adora feeding seat features our trademark bright floral pattern and easily attaches to most surfaces and accommodates most dolls from 12"-20"! 2964.title: Grabolo

2965.title: Disney Descendants Neon Lights Feature Mal of Isle of the Lost
2965.description: ["At the Neon Lights Ball, Mal Isle of the Lost's glowing outfit steals the spotlight! 2966.title: ALEX Toys The Secret Life of Pets Shrinky Dinks Activity Set
2966.description: ["The Secret Life of Pets Shrinky Dinks Activity Set gives you characters from the movie that you can color, bake and shrink, turning them into stand up figurines! Make Max, Duke, Sweet Pea, Buddy, Chloe and Mel as well as Snowball and some of his minions! Keep them locked up in the house all day or sneak them out with you for some daytime adventures. Includes 17 precut preprinted Shrinky Dinks, 6 colored pencils, key ring with chain, 12 paperboard stands, 3 jump rings and easy instructions. Recommended for children 5 years of age and older."]

2967.title: Green Toys Storybook Gift Set Includes Launch Boat & Storybook
2967.description: ['The Green Toys storybook series extends the beloved Green Toys brand into print. Includes 1 launch boat, 1 Captain duck, and 1 32-page hardcover storybook. Conveniently packaged, ready to gift!']

2968.title: Barbie Star Light Adventure Lights & Sounds Hoverboarder
2968.description: ["Based on the space fantasy movie Barbie Star Light Adventure, this galactic hoverboarder doll is out of this world! Join Barbie and her friends as they travel through a galaxy of sparkling stars and colorful characters. This famous hoverboarder doll befriends Barbie in the movie and brings the story to life with lights and sounds. Snap the doll's silvery boots into the detachable hoverboard to get ready for the action. Activate three colored lights (pink, red and blue) and more than five different sounds by moving the doll on the hoverboard -- different moves result in different effects so it seems as though she is really hoverboarding! Attach the included rotating ring in the back of the doll, and use it to see her perform 360-degree stunts. Articulated knees expand her flexibility and the possibilities for action. Practice extreme moves and perfect the routine for her mission to the stars. Fly into adventure or soar into imagination! The character doll is fashion forward in a futuristic purple molded jumpsuit with silvery boots and a removable shimmery silvery skirt. Matching silvery shimmer streaks in her purple ponytail add super cool style. Recreate favorite scenes from the movie, or let your imagination lift off! Collect all of the dolls and accessories from Barbie Star Light Adventure to expand the possibilities to the ends of the universe (each sold separately, subject to availability). Includes hoverboarder doll wearing fashions and hoverboard with doll-activated lights and sounds feature. Doll cannot stand or fly alone. Colors and decorations may vary."]

2969.title: ALEX Spa Fab Foil Nail Roller
2969.description: ['ALEX Spa Fab Foil Nail Roller puts sparkly color right on your nails without using a brush. Just roll on some color, decorate with a sticker and brush on some topcoat to protect. (14.5cm. x 16.5cm.), storage pouch and easy instructions. Recommended for children 8 years of age and older.']

2970.title: BRIO Lifting Bridge
2970.description: ['Founded in Sweden in 1884, Brio makes the highest quality wooden toys that have delighted children and created happy memories for generations. Both educational and fun, Brio\'s uncompromising focus on design, quality and craftsmanship create toys of lasting value that stimulate creativity and imagination. Engaging play and learning are integral themes in all Brio toys, satisfying a child\'s educational needs and growing with them through their various phases of development. Add some vertical excitement to your Brio universe with the Lifting Bridge. Raise and lower the classic draw bridge with a simple turn of the handle in the control room. Lower the safety gates when you want to raise the bridge to let something pass beneath. Once you get the "all clear", lower the bridge and raise the gates and your train is on its way. The Lifting Bridge comes complete with the bridge assembly, control room and two connecting sections of track. Made from solid Beech wood and sanded smooth, the Lifting Bridge fits seamlessly into all Brio wooden railway sets.', 'Founded in Sweden in 1884, Brio makes the highest quality wooden toys that have delighted children and created happy memories for generations. 2972.title: VTech Crawl & Cuddle Fire Truck

2973.title: Barbie Star Light Galaxy Barbie Doll & Flying Cat

2975.title: Ever After High Epic Winter Daring Charming and Rosabella Beauty Dolls 2-Pack

2976.title: WWE Crash Cage Play Set
2976.description: ['Get ready to launch into action and recreate exciting WWE matches! 2979.title: ALEX Toys Craft Super Sweet Wristlet
2979.description: ['ALEX Toys Craft Super Sweet Wristlet lets you carry candy, school supplies, money, tickets and so much more, wherever you go! Includes preprinted wristlet with rainbow iridescent trim and 5 permanent markers. Recommended for children 5 years of age and older.']

2980.title: VTech Brilliant Baby Laptop (Frustration Free Packaging)

Thoughtfully designed for play on-the-go, this adorable playhouse is sure to capture imaginations anywhere. The best part? It folds up in seconds to store everything inside. 2987.description: ['Unlock the mysteries of common minerals with the Toysmith mineral Science Kit. The Mineral Science Kit teaches how to test, classify and identify different kinds of minerals.
